title: Uncle Julio's: Line Temp Log
briefing: Opening shift. Grab the thermometer and log every station: walk-in proteins, freezer, queso hot hold, fajita line reach-in, rice and beans steam table. FDA says 41°F–135°F is the danger zone. Prove you know it.

expertRecipe.name: Uncle Julio's Temperature Logging Standard
expertRecipe.platingStandard: All five stations logged within safe range. Zero readings in the danger zone. Thermometer calibrated first.

steps.instruction: Calibrate thermometer in ice bath. Must read 32°F ± 2°F.
steps.whyExplanation: A thermometer reading 5°F high means your 'safe' 38°F walk-in is actually 43°F — above the danger threshold. Every reading after this is wrong.

steps.instruction: Walk-in cooler: probe air temp between protein shelves. Must be 33-40°F.
steps.whyExplanation: Marinated chicken and raw skirt steak live here. Above 40°F, bacteria on raw protein doubles every 20 minutes. Below 33°F, marinade freezes and the texture changes.

steps.instruction: Freezer: confirm 0°F or below. Check shrimp and dessert items.
steps.whyExplanation: Frozen shrimp above 0°F starts slow-thawing. Ice crystals damage cell walls, making shrimp mushy when cooked. Chocolate piñata shells soften and crack.

steps.instruction: Queso hot hold: must be 135°F or above. Stir and probe center.
steps.whyExplanation: Queso is a TCS food. Below 135°F it enters the danger zone. Uncle Julio's queso sits on the line all service — if it drops below 135°F, you must reheat to 165°F or discard.

steps.instruction: Fajita line reach-in: confirm 33-40°F. Check prepped peppers, onions, and sliced proteins.
steps.whyExplanation: Prepped fajita vegetables and sliced proteins sit here all service. Out-of-range reach-in means every fajita platter is suspect.

steps.instruction: Steam table: rice and beans must be 135°F or above.
steps.whyExplanation: Cooked rice grows Bacillus cereus rapidly in the danger zone. Refried beans are high-moisture, high-protein — perfect bacteria food. Both must stay above 135°F.

criticalControlPoints.consequence: All subsequent readings untrustworthy. Every temp log for the shift is invalid.
Queso in danger zone for 4+ hours must be discarded. At $2.20/quart, that's a full batch wasted.
Bacillus cereus in rice causes vomiting within 1-5 hours. Cannot be killed by reheating.
